2026-11-16.patch_summary: This patch fixes a bug in the Linux kernel's migration device code that causes memory leaks when splitting huge pages during migration. The issue occurs because migrate_vma_split_unmapped_folio() takes an extra reference to a folio, which is not dropped if the PMD is split into PTE migration entries before the helper takes the PMD lock. The patch removes this extra reference by using the freeze = false mode in split_huge_pmd_address(), which keeps the source folio alive even if its PMD migration entry no longer exists.
